outcome: Venturing with no dungeon in the command zone puts a dungeon there with the venture marker on its topmost room.
Venturing from a non-bottom room moves the venture marker to an adjacent room and fires that room's ability.
Venturing from the bottommost room completes the dungeon, removes it, and starts a new dungeon at its topmost room.
Venture into a quality chooses a dungeon with that quality when none is in the command zone, else ventures normally.
